Jobs: Post Doc in Cities University College Dublin

Andy CASA, UCL East

The School of Geography, Planning and Environmental Policy is advertising a Post-Doctoral research position looking at cities.

The research project, which is a EU 6th framework project, explores city and regional competitiveness with a particular focus on the idea of the creative class and the creative city.

Candidates should have a PhD (or be near to completion of a PhD) in urban/economic/regional geography or in a related subject. For further information about the post please contact Dr. Declan Redmond at declan.redmond@ucd.ie

The post is funded by the European Commission and is for two years, starting on September 1st 2008. Salary is approximately €38,000 to €45,000 per annum depending on qualifications and experience.

To apply for this position please forward (by e-mail) a letter of application and a Curriculum Vitae (naming 2 referees) to Dr. Declan Redmond by July 16th, 2008.

See http://www2.fmg.uva.nl/acre/ for more information on the research area.
